subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming Annual Employee Appreciation Day on Friday, August 20th. This event is a great opportunity for us to celebrate our hard work and dedication throughout the year. There will be games, food, and prizes for everyone to enjoy. Please mark your calendars and RSVP by August 10th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, HR Team
